objective: Classify locally observed web pages as judi or non_judi for the Gamblock-AI prototype.
unit_of_observation: One captured URL and page-content snapshot.
license_evidence: The Kaggle dataset page is the claimed source. A secondary mirror reports Apache-2.0, but the license has not been verified from Kaggle metadata or the dataset owner and is not treated as a redistribution authorization.
known_limitations: Four raw rows are absent from the frozen clean snapshot and no exclusion reason is recorded.
Collection dates, legal or ethical basis, annotators, and adjudication are not available in the repository; the Kaggle license remains unverified.

The local snapshot is a binary judi/non_judi selection; the original Kaggle-derived mirror exposes additional label values, so the exact upstream filtering procedure must be documented before claiming full-source coverage.
The frozen split is row-stratified rather than grouped by registrable domain or site family.
